content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Graduate with good academic record from a recognized University/Institute; Desirable: Post Graduate Diploma or Degree in Personnel Management/Human Resources Management or MBA/PGDM/PGPM from a recognized University/Institute Experience: Category-I: Priority to applicants with 5 years experience during the last 10 years in HR/IR/Personnel. Category-III: mandatory experience of five years during the last ten years as functional head of Projects/Plants having direct responsibility of at least 20% of the workforce. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for PESB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for PESB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for PESB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 45 years (on the date of occurrence of vacancy (DOV)). Relaxation: Internal Maximum: 2 years residual service as on the date of vacancy w.r.t. the date of superannuation, Others Maximum: 3 years residual service as on the date of vacancy w.r.t. the date of superannuation.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduate with good academic record from a recognized University/Institute; PG Diploma/Degree in Personnel Management/HRM or MBA/PGDM/PGPM desirable; experience in HR/IR/Personnel or as functional head of Projects/Plants as per Category I/II/III.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. SPSEs, private companies, JVs and federations must have an annual turnover of Rs. 5,000 crore or more. CPSE applicants need one year (internal) or two years (others) in the eligible scale on the date of vacancy. Group 'A' officers must hold a Joint Secretary level or equivalent post on substantive basis. Public Sector Bank/FI applicants must be at Board level or one level below for one year; Armed Forces at Major General or equivalent rank.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applicants employed in a contractual or ad-hoc capacity. Officers drawing the eligible pay scale merely on account of NFU/NBR without holding a substantive post.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of applicants. Interview. Board reserves the right to shortlist applicants for interview as per extant guidelines. Shortlisting also considers guidelines in PESB letter No. 5/4/2021-PESB dated 05.08.2022.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment for five years from the date of joining or up to the date of superannuation or until further orders, whichever is earlier. Central Government officers, Armed Forces, AIS and PSB/FI/Autonomous Body officers considered only on immediate absorption basis.
